text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout rlf-20260322-01 for api-gateway (v1 -> v2) at 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z. Operator eyes requested. Canary 10% for 15m then 50% for 20m.

maria: tagging ops-lead @ops-lead — can we hold 00:30 for a quiet window? mobile SDK telemetry still shows ~18% on v1 in EU.

jason: what does the deploybot canary signal look for? errors, 5xx, header mismatch?

deploy-bot: Canary checks: 5xx rate (>1.5% over 5m), client-version header mismatch (>25% of requests), token auth error spike, and latency p50 > baseline +200ms. Will auto-pause and notify if threshold breached.

sylvie: FYI release-notes draft at https://confluence/redwood/release/rlf-20260322 - includes breaking header case change. We should remind SDK teams.

maria: if mobile still at 18% v1, we should gate EU region for the first 50% stage. Can we target global canary but exclude eu-west-1 until mobile patch ships?

deploy-bot: rollout config supports region-scoping. Command preview: 
```
/deploy rlf-20260322-01 --canary 10% --canary-duration 15m --stage2 50% --stage2-duration 20m --exclude-region eu-west-1
```

jason: 👍 do that. Also add a pinlist check: tenants with older SDK (<1.4.2) should be pinned to v1 for 24h post-rollout.

ops-lead: +1 on pinlist. Can we set automated rollback criteria: any sustained 5xx >2% for 10m OR client-version mismatch >40% during any stage -> immediate rollback. Otherwise manual rollback with ops approval.

maria: sounds good. Add a soft-fallback route option too: if mismatch detected, route to v1 for affected tenant ids rather than full rollback. That saves churn.

sylvie: implementing tenant-level diversion will take a quick shim; ops, can you be prepared to enable diversion for up to 6 tenants?

ops-lead: we'll have operator runbook ready. Outline: detect, confirm via logs, enable diversion with `rb divert enable --tenant <id> --target v1`, monitor 10m, then either reattempt v2 or keep pin.

jason: I'll update the release notes with explicit rollback criteria and the tenant diversion steps. Also adding line: "Clients must send X-Client-Version header with semantic version >=1.4.2."

maria: one more ask — schedule a short post-rollout check-in at +30m with product and SDK leads. Add to calendar after deploy.

deploy-bot: Rollout queued with exclusions and pinlist precheck. Final command executed at 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z unless aborted by @maria or @ops-lead. Will post status updates and canary telemetry in this thread. :rocket:
